title: Handy Little Egg Cooker Makes Good Poached Eggs
text:
Handy Little Egg Cooker Makes Good Poached Eggs. This CHEFMAN ELECTRIC EGG COOKER (Makes 6 Eggs; Midnight Blue) has a small countertop footprint, and cooks eggs quickly. It has an audible alarm that tells you when your eggs are done (omelet, poached, hard-, medium-, or soft-boiled).

The cooker poaches 1 or 2 eggs at a time. My first poached eggs came out too soft (undercooked whites), but I fixed this by adding more cooking water than the instructions called for in the second batch. The poached eggs are almost as good as the ones I make in hot water on the stovetop, and they’re a lot less trouble.

The cooker makes up to 6 hard-cooked eggs at a time. Mine came out as expected, but one egg cracked open during cooking. (I think that it had a hairline crack before I started.) This meant a bit of extra cleanup, but it wasn’t a disaster.

Probably I will continue to use my Instant Pot for cooking hard-boiled eggs, because the Chefman doesn’t cook Large eggs quite as thoroughly as I like. (I hard-cook older eggs in batches, and then store them for several days in the refrigerator.) The Chefman is easier and faster than the Instant Pot, if the hard-boiled eggs will be eaten right away.

For optimal results, it might be best to use Medium eggs. However, Large eggs cook adequately, especially if you add a little more water to increase the cooking time. (Just be sure NOT to overfill the base.)

The parts of the Chefman egg cooker are top-shelf dishwasher safe (except, of course, for the base).

features: NO MORE GUESSWORK: Easily boil, poach, or steam up to 6 eggs in minutes, faster than stovetop method. Use the included measuring cup to know how much water you need depending on the style of egg. The ready buzzer will signal once your eggs are finished cooking.

READY FOR BREAKFAST? No need to wait for your hard-boiled eggs to cool to move them after cooking. With the tray lifting tool, you can have your brunch with hot, freshly cooked eggs. Whether you like your eggs hard or soft boiled, scrambled, omelet or poached, breakfast has never been easier!

COMPACT & EASY TO CLEAN: BPA-Free lid, cooking and poaching trays are top rack dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. No more fighting over whose turn it is to do the dishes thanks to this versatile, convenient egg cooker. The compact size is perfect for any kitchen, college dorms, travel, and more!

NOT JUST FOR EGGS: Not only can you steam eggs to hard-boiled perfection or create tender poached eggs, but you can also steam a variety of vegetables, making this an even more versatile kitchen tool for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snack time. The perfect Holiday gift for anyone on your list!

RESOURCES: cETL approved with advanced safety technology for long lasting durability, & 1-year assurance provided by Chefman, so you can purchase worry-free - we've got your back! For information on how to use your product, scroll down for a PDF User Guide. 360 Watts/120 Volts
description: THE BEST WAY TO COOK EGGS Have your eggs the way you like best without the guesswork. Cooked hard boiled or soft boiled, poached eggs or scrambled, you can now easily do it all with the Chefman Electric Egg Cooker. Decide on how you prefer your eggs, pour water into the heating plate, place the desired tray and eggs, cover, and your eggs are cooking with the push of a button. Use the piercing pin with the included measuring cup to prevent shells from cracking. SAVE TIME Make more eggs faster, using less energy than boiling water. Created with you in mind, this Egg Cooker will change your hectic mornings and serve your family a healthy meal. Your eggs can be garnished to your liking, too. You will find easy and clear instructions in the user guide on how to use your Egg Cooker and how to customize the settings so your eggs will be made perfectly. No need to wait for the eggs to cool to move them after cooking - with the tray lifting tool, you can have your breakfast with hot, freshly cooked eggs. Moving hot eggs has never been this easy! FEATURES: The power button with an indicator light buzzes when eggs are ready. Removable egg tray lets you boil up to 6 eggs at a time and remove the eggs right away to cool them under running water after cooking. Separate poaching tray for easy poached eggs. As easy to clean and store as it is to use, the cooking trays and measuring cup are top rack dishwasher safe. cETL approved with advanced safety technology, long lasting durability, and 1-year limited provided by Chefman.
